title: How Do I Use BloFin Earn? (App)
notes: First-party guidance documenting active Flexible and Fixed BloFin Earn subscription options by August 2025.

title: BloFin Earn Service Agreement
notes: Current first-party agreement covering Flexible, Fixed and Auto-Earn. It says users are legal owners of deposited assets, entrust and authorize BloFin as intermediary to act on subscribed assets, and BloFin does not guarantee repayment of principal or displayed interest.

title: BloFin Simple Earn FAQ
notes: Current first-party FAQ describing Flexible and Fixed Simple Earn, supported assets and redemption. Promotional safety wording is not treated as overriding the governing agreement's non-guarantee and risk clauses.

title: BloFin Earn product page
notes: Current first-party product surface confirming continuing Earn availability in 2026.

title: LBank Earn Service Agreement
notes: Current first-party agreement stating Earn is not principal-protected, users may face partial or total principal loss, assets may be aggregated, and LBank may pledge, lend, provide liquidity, hedge or otherwise use assets to generate returns.

title: How to Participate in LBank Spot Earn? (Web)
notes: First-party Spot Earn guide describing flexible account use, first-month LBank subsidy and later yield based on actual arbitrage returns from professional quantitative institutions.

title: LBank Spot Earn User Guide
notes: First-party guide describing Spot Earn flexibility, institutional arbitrage yield source for that product and subordinated-fund / liquidation risk controls. Those controls are not generalized into a universal principal guarantee.

title: LBank Product Updates - December 2025
notes: First-party retrospective confirming the newly upgraded one-stop LBank Earn center and expansion of Earn products in December 2025.
